verdict.rationale: Runloop documents an MCP Hub feature that gives agents running in Devboxes access to MCP tool servers without exposing credentials. That is a first-party mechanism for plugging MCP servers in so agents can use their tools, but the evidence is a single one-line page summary with no detail on how servers are registered or which transports and servers are supported. The official-MCP-server probe concerns the separate server role and is not credited here. Missing for 10: documented steps for registering or configuring MCP servers, supported transports and server types, how tools are exposed to the agent, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Give your agents access to MCP tool servers without exposing credentials
